headlines: SPY about -0.6% premarket after yesterday's +2.5% close; VIX about 20 (last snapshot)
US CPI and core CPI were due 13:30Z today; I could not confirm the actual print
Stocktwits trending: TTD -6.8%, QBTS -6.2%, NVDA -1.4%, TTWO +3.9% premarket

rumors.text: Posters say a 50bps Fed hike in December is now possible after a spike in bond yields; others expect only 25bps
rumors.why: If true, a faster hiking path would pressure equities and long bonds

rumors.text: Posters claim the market is being held up by a plunge protection team or intervention
rumors.why: If true, dips would be bought; no evidence given

rumors.text: Posters say oil is dropping hard, so November CPI could print negative
rumors.why: If true, lower inflation would ease hike fears and support stocks

plays.reason: Premarket weak after a +2.5% gap-up, crowd chatter of a bond-yield spike and bigger hike odds; but CPI result unverified
plays.catalyst: US CPI reaction at the open

readings.whats_new: SPY flipped from +2.5% yesterday to about -0.6% premarket, with VIX near 20 and fear and greed about 31. Crowd chatter has moved from CPI-leak talk to worry over bond yields and a possible 50bps December hike; the CPI print itself could not be confirmed. Stocktwits SPY sentiment edged up to 56.
